description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing the living weapon ability granted by Ekthi to trigger.
Resolve the living weapon trigger granted by Ekthi, creating (and attaching the Equipment that entered to) a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ token plus creating an additional artifact token through Tippy-Toe (which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis), causing the living weapon ability granted by Ekthi to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
